invariants.text: Client.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Invoice.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Invoice.client_id must reference an existing Client.id
Payment.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Payment.invoice_id must reference an existing Invoice.id
The amount of an invoice must be greater than zero.
The due date of an invoice must be after or on the current date.
A payment must be associated with an invoice that exists in the system.
The amount of a payment must be greater than zero.
An invoice is considered outstanding if its payment has not been recorded or if the payment amount is less than the invoice amount.
A client must have a valid email address to be created in the system.
A payment cannot be made for an invoice that has already been fully paid.
The sum of all payments made against an invoice must not exceed the invoice amount.
An invoice can only be linked to one client.
A payment must have a payment date that is on or after the invoice's due date.
